若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。

packages.headline: Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls will continue its Year 1 DLC roadmap with Thor (Jane Foster) this winter, with two more characters coming in 2027.
Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027
Developer Arc System Works confirmed the lineup alongside Evo France 2026. The Jane Foster version of Asgard's God of Thunder is now officially set to follow Phoenix Cyclops after he releases November 2, 2026, with today's announcement coming with both a sneak peek at her Marvel Tokon model in Odin's Vault on Asgard.
The clip doesn't show too much, only teasing that we'll probably see Jane fight off Loki while wielding Mjolnir when a proper gameplay trailer premieres at a later date. Arc System Works said she's scheduled to launch in Marvel Tokon "winter 2027," so expect to see her arrival sometime before March of next year. Despite some concerns from players that poor sales could jeopardize the Marvel fighting game's future, at least two more characters will arrive in spring and summer 2027, too.
That means Marvel Tokon players will get to see them fight the rest of the tag-team fighting with and against the game's roster – which includes characters like Doctor Doom, Iron Man, Carnage, Magneto, and more – in Arc System Works' heightened style. Although the details surrounding each DLC release are unclear, the reveal trailer did at least confirm that Venom will also come with a stage based on the Symbiote home world of Klyntar.
It's all part of the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass, which costs $34.99. A roadmap with some of the most beloved characters from Marvel history would usually be enough to have comic book and video game fans frothing at the mouth, but uncertainty surrounding the project might have some looking at the Evo announcement in a different light.
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls launched to strong reviews (a 9/10 from IGN) in August, but at least on PC, players have struggled. Its Steam launch brought mixed reviews from fans who complained of widespread technical issues and PlayStation Network requirements. Even as the developers almost immediately promised to investigate the issues, it didn't take long for the backlash to swell to the point that famed fighting game community member Maximilian Dood wrote off playing the PC version altogether .
It only took a few days for Arc System Works to push out a fix for most players' issues , but as Steam player numbers still struggle to break even 1,000 concurrent users (via SteamDB ), even the developers have admitted earning back trust will be "extremely challenging." While Marvel Tokon's presence on PlayStation 5 seemed to go over well, director Kazuto Sekine eventually went on to apologize for the PC launch .
Yes, Spider-Man anti-hero and Symbiote menace Venom will finally join the roster in spring 2027. X-Men firecracker Jubilee will then follow in the summer of that year. While Cyclops and Thor are entering the fray as relatively lesser-known versions of themselves, Venom and Jubilee appear to be mostly straightforward.

sources.label: PC Gamer
sources.evidenceText:
I wanna be a part of it, New York, New York.
Finding the best discounts on PC gaming hardware has never been more important. Check out our handpicked hardware deals.
Deadlock's City Never Sleeps update makes Valve's MOBA my favorite videogame setting in years
Deadlock isn't technically out yet—but it's pretty easy to get into, with invites to its beta being generously granted by Valve and obtainable in plenty of Discord communities if you don't have other mates who're into MOBA s. And boy howdy, have I not regretted a single one of my 350 hours over the past couple years "testing" this game.
I've plenty of glowing words for Deadlock, but its latest update, City Never Sleeps, is like seeing one of the last few hammer-blows of a masterpiece. The entire map's been completely overhauled , with new neutral monsters and a richly-textured remake of its areas, though "remake" doesn't seem like the right word.
Deadlock's character designs are all delightful —but the new roster of heroes is legitimately some of Valve's best work yet. It's kinda telling that the least interesting character, an art student named Violet, is still super charming, with paint smudges on her legs tying the whole aesthetic together.
All of this combined has made Deadlock's Cursed Apple one of my new favourite videogame settings basically ever—so appealing and interesting to me that I almost wish it wasn't wrapped up in a MOBA. However, even if you aren't going to devote the hundreds of hours of masochism required to understand this unassailable genre, I still recommend you check Deadlock out and just soak in its vibes. It's an unfinished masterwork that's almost taken shape.

packages.headline: How to Check and Update Graphics Card

sources.label: GameRant Gaming
sources.evidenceText:
Learn how to check and update graphics card drivers for better gaming performance, stability, and FPS.
How to Check and Update Graphics Card
Graphics card drivers are what keep your GPU running properly. For PC gamers , they matter even more because they directly affect game performance, stability, and FPS. If your drivers are old or not working properly, you’ll probably notice stuttering, crashes, or games not running as smoothly as they should.
Thankfully, you can check and update your graphics card drivers on Windows 10 or Windows 11 using Device Manager, Windows Update, or the official NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel software, depending on your setup.
How to Check Graphics Card in Device Manager
To see what graphics card is installed on your computer, open the Start menu and search for Device Manager, then open it.
Inside Device Manager, look for Display Adapters and click the small arrow next to it. This will show all graphics cards currently installed on your system. Some computers may show one GPU while others may show two, such as integrated Intel graphics and a dedicated NVIDIA or AMD graphics card .
If you are not sure which GPU you actually have, you can also open Task Manager, go to the Performance tab, and click on GPU. This will clearly show the exact model name of your graphics card and make things a lot easier.
How to Update Graphics Card in Device Manager

packages.headline: Popular Shooter Quadruples Player Numbers With 'Spider-Man Grapple' Update

sources.label: GameRant Gaming
sources.evidenceText:
One popular shooter has more than quadrupled its recent player count after a major update introduced a much-praised new traversal mechanic.
Popular Shooter Quadruples Player Numbers With 'Spider-Man Grapple' Update
ARC Raiders has seen its Steam player count more than quadruple after the release of Frozen Trail, a massive new update that adds a grappling hook, letting players swing around like Spider-Man. The latest ARC Raiders update appears to have given Embark Studios' extraction shooter a major second wind nearly a year after launch.
PvPvE shooter ARC Raiders arrived in October 2025 and quickly became one of the year's biggest multiplayer releases, eventually reaching a Steam all-time peak of 481,966 concurrent players in January per SteamDB. That enormous audience gradually settled down as the months passed, with September peaking at just 39,900 players and averaging roughly 21,000 at any given time. Those numbers are hardly enough to call the game dead, but they show how far ARC Raiders has fallen from its launch-day phenomenon to a more long-term player base. Frozen Trail has now given many of those lapsed players a reason to head Topside again.
In a surprising announcement, ARC Raiders is collaborating with a restaurant chain to offer players special in-game rewards and cosmetics.
ARC Raiders Jumps From 39,900 to More Than 185,000 Steam Players
Since Frozen Trail launched on October 8, ARC Raiders has climbed to a new 24-hour Steam peak of 185,443 concurrent players, roughly 4.6 times September's high and its strongest showing since March. There is an important caveat, however, as Embark is also letting players access the full game for free across PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S through October 12, so the update and the free weekend have clearly worked in tandem to create such a sudden jump in players. Still, getting more than 185,000 people online again shows that plenty of former and prospective Raiders were waiting for a good reason to jump back in.
One of ARC Raiders Frozen Trail's newest additions seems to be stealing much of the attention, and could be one of the big reasons people are coming back to the game. The new Grappling Hook gives Raiders another way to traverse the environment, including swinging across gaps and reaching powerful positions, inevitably leading to comparisons with Spider-Man. Players on Reddit have shared stories of swinging around Cargo Dock, climbing above patrolling ARC enemies, and generally experimenting with how far the gadget can take them. Others have praised the update for making ARC Raiders feel fresh again, with one returning player describing it as almost like playing a new game.
Moreover, Frozen Trail is much more than one new movement gadget, and fans have noticed. Embark calls it one of the game's biggest updates since launch, adding the snowy Pendola Pass map, new ARC enemies, weapons, an Outpost and Research Bench, 22 quests, a revamped Skill Tree, a new Reward Pass system, and several new tools alongside the Grappling Hook. This update's scale is particularly notable because Embark has abandoned its original plan for monthly major updates to ARC Raiders earlier this year, arguing the pace wasn't sustainable and left little room for meaningful changes. Major updates will now arrive twice per year, with Frozen Trail serving as the first real example of what that slower approach can deliver.

packages.headline: ‘I’m Shocked That People Are Still Playing’ – How GTA 5 Took Over the World

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Could GTA 6 be as big as its predecessor? We take a look at how GTA 5 became one of the biggest games in history, selling over 230m copies and being played by millions of people every week for over a decade.
‘I’m Shocked That People Are Still Playing’ – How GTA 5 Took Over the World
Over a decade and three console generations, GTA 5 has become much more than a crime simulator.
There are over 230 million copies of Grand Theft Auto 5 in the world. As the second-highest selling game of all time, it has been played for billions of hours by players across the globe, making it one of the most significant pastimes in the entire world. That’s an impressive achievement for what in 2013 was simply the highly-anticipated next entry in Rockstar’s beloved (and notorious) open-world crime series. But GTA 5 proved to be much, much more than a typical sequel. It has become home to a huge, expressive, and loyal community, one which has made a digital hobby of everything from warring alien clans to producing slick vehicle stunt movies.
This is the story of how a video game became much more than a crime simulator.
Ash Skyqueen’s avatar weaves between the traffic of busy Dorset Drive on a motorbike spouting flames. Suddenly she veers, mounting the pavement at high speed and rebounding from the roof of a bus stop to achieve incredible air. Momentum carries her through a perfect circle, barely bigger than a human body, that forms the second ‘O’ of the ‘LIQUOR HOLE’ store sign. Pulling the ripcord of her parachute, she lands with a slight stagger at the door of the rundown booze establishment on Eclipse Boulevard - a couple of streets over from where her jump began.
It’s the first feat in a stunt montage which Ash put together to celebrate ten years of GTA 5 – the game that gave her freedom, companionship and goals when she was robbed of all three. “I’d had a ruptured disc in my spine, so I was bed bound shortly after the game came out,” she says. “All day every day for about three years straight, it became my therapy in a way. You’re stuck in bed, can’t do anything, can’t work, no social life, a pretty miserable existence. And then I’m suddenly connected to a community of people doing the same thing. It kept me from going insane.”
It’s a striking demonstration of why GTA 5 has remained a deeply important game to millions of players. A pillar of pop culture, it was erected in 2013 and has loomed over the entertainment industries during every year since. Thanks to the enduring love for its single-player story campaign and its ever-popular, seemingly invincible online mode, GTA 5 has spanned three console generations and made around $10 billion dollars for publisher Take-Two – over 3 times more than the highest-grossing movie ever. When Shawn Levy and Ryan Reynolds made Free Guy, a Hollywood comedy about the social connection and wanton violence of online games, it was GTA they chose to riff on.
Where previous Grand Theft Auto entries were cinema-riffing crime simulators that routinely broke sales records, GTA 5 has evolved beyond those confines. It has become an alternate world where players can escape to a funhouse mirror version of LA – the most mythologised city on the planet. There they become whoever they want to be: stunt specialist, bank robber, nightclub kid, hitchhiker or filmmaker.

Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Says He'd Return to the Doom Series "In a Heartbeat"
"There are a lot of dominoes that would have to fall in a very specific way for that to occur," said Gordon. "If those dominoes ever fell in that way, I would. Of course. Within a heartbeat."
However, "hundreds of dominoes would have to fall into place" in order to make it happen.
Mick Gordon, the legendary Aussie composer who brought a headbang to every headshot in 2016's Doom and its 2020 follow-up Doom Eternal, has told IGN that he's open to the idea of contributing to future instalments in id Software's iconic shooter series. During an interview conducted at this weekend's PAX Australia, Gordon seemed to indicate that his involvement with Doom isn't necessarily done for good, despite the very public falling-out that occurred between the composer and Doom Eternal's development team in the wake of its release.
Gordon didn't elaborate on exactly what those "dominoes" might be, but it's possible that disputes between the composer and Doom Eternal's executive producer Marty Stratton have yet to be fully resolved. In a lengthy 2022 post on Medium , Gordon accused developer id Software of failing to pay him for half of his work on the Doom Eternal soundtrack, and singled out Stratton as being a recurringly abusive presence throughout his work on the score and the OST. However, it certainly seems as though the experience hasn't dimmed Gordon's love for Doom itself.

Call of Duty fans are torn about NetEase Games' ECC: Redline, a new FPS that many have called a "rip-off" with the power to fill the void for frustrated Warzone players.
New NetEase FPS Sparks Warzone 'Rip-Off' Claims, But Some Call of Duty Fans Are Happy to See It
NetEase called its new shooter a "self-developed extreme-sports tactical shooter" when revealing it just days ago. It's yet another big swing from the China-based tech company that boasts breakneck gameplay on PC via Steam and mobile devices, but in the hours since its big debut, it's also been called a "1:1 rip" of Activision's Call of Duty: Warzone, and it's not too hard to see why.
Viewers say guns look, kick, and move in a way that seems familiar, but the similarities don't stop there. Everything down the UI is being investigated by FPS enjoyers, too, with things like the sound effects also evoking the same kind of gritty action Call of Duty is known for. Even the way the first-person camera blurs when dropping from heights might feel familiar to fans of Warzone and other shooters. Even with characters that present their own unique abilities and gadgets, ECC: Redline has had a hard time escaping the comparisons online.
"Warzone + Delta Force + Blood Strike = ECC: Redline," one YouTube comment left on NetEase's official upload said .
"It’s 1-to-1 Warzone, hilarious s**t," another commenter on Reddit said .
Meanwhile, Call of Duty has faced its own struggles in the six years since the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare reboot introduced Warzone in 2019. Like so many other popular ongoing FPS experiences, the battle royale offshoot's popularity has ebbed and flowed, with many of its millions of fans often still calling back to its launch build and its first map, Verdansk, as the glory days.

packages.headline: Steamの新たな放置RPG『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』を仕事中に遊んだら「脳内の優先順位」が壊れた。放置中も止まらないビルド思考、仕事はもはや“待ち時間”

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
放置型RPG『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』は、いつのまにか“作業が片手間”になってしまうゲームだった。
Steamの新たな放置RPG『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』を仕事中に遊んだら「脳内の優先順位」が壊れた。放置中も止まらないビルド思考、仕事はもはや“待ち時間”
パブリッシャーのInfini Funは、One Interactive Studioが手がける『 ファンタジー放置遠征隊 』を10月9日に配信開始した。対応プラットフォームはPC（ Steam ）。本作は必要になる手動操作がほどほどでありながも、重厚なビルドシステムを備えている点が特徴。本稿では、作業中につい本作をプレイしてしまったがために、作業中の脳内を“占領”されてしまった筆者の体験談をお届けしていこう。
『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』は、JRPG風のキャラクターたちで遠征隊を編成し、デスクトップ上でオートバトルを繰り広げる放置型RPG。最大4人のパーティを組み、敵を倒して装備を集め、仲間を育てながら大陸最強の遠征隊を目指していく。
『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』のゲームサイクルは放置系RPGとして王道だ。仲間キャラクターである「デュエリスト」を最大4人まで編成してステージへ送り出す。戦闘は完全自動で進行し、敵を倒せば経験値、拠点建築などに使う素材、装備品などを入手できる。一定数を撃破してボスを倒せば、次のステージが開放される仕組みだ。
以上が、今回『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』をプレイして得た所感だ。Steamに数多く存在する放置ゲームの中には、ゲームとしての介入の余地を削ぎ落としたシンプルな作品もあれば、頻繁な手動操作を要求する作品も少なくない。そのなかで本作が印象的だったのは、「放置の手軽さ」と「育成の奥深さ」が互いを引き立て合っている点だ。レベル上げや素材収集といった成長の積み重ねは遠征隊に任せられる一方、ひとたび育成方針を考え始めれば、仲間選びや装備、クラス構成など、さまざまな試行錯誤が待っている。
『 ファンタジー放置遠征隊 』はPC（ Steam ）向けに10月9日配信予定。現在は デモ版 が配信中だ。
Steamの新たな放置RPG『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』を仕事中に遊んだら「脳内の優先順位」が壊れた。放置中も止まらないビルド思考、仕事はもはや“待ち時間”
今回、弊誌は本作を先行プレイする機会に恵まれたが、序盤の画面を開いた筆者を迎えたのは、予想以上の要素の多さだった。キャラクター管理、装備厳選、酒場や鍛冶屋、クラス分岐など、育成に関わるアイコンがズラリと並ぶ。放置ゲーム特有のシンプルな手触りをイメージしていると、初見ではこの密度の濃さに少し驚かされるかもしれない。
そして実際に触ってみると「操作量は極めて少ないのに、思考量が凄まじい」という本作の本質が見えてくるだろう。画面を放置している間も、頭の中では「次はどのクラスへ派生させようか」「戦士は攻撃特化か防御特化か」といった試行錯誤が止まらない。作業の片手間に遊ぶつもりが、いつしか思考の大部分を本作の育成プランに占領され、“本来の作業が片手間に”なっていく。ここからは、この没頭感がどのように生み出されているのか、実際のプレイサイクルを紐解いていく。

packages.headline: Steam無料エンドレスフライトゲーム『飛んで行け！100km！山だ！』、11月16日に有料化へ。今ならタダ

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains!は10月9日、『飛んで行け！100km！山だ！』を11月16日に有料化すると発表した。本作は奥スクロールのエンドレスフライトゲームだ。
Steam無料エンドレスフライトゲーム『飛んで行け！100km！山だ！』、11月16日に有料化へ。今ならタダ
デベロッパーのFly Over! 100KM! Mountains!は10月9日、『 飛んで行け！100km！山だ！ 』を11月16日に有料化すると発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、ゲーム内は日本語表示に対応している。ライブラリに追加しておけば、有料化後も無料でプレイすることが可能だ。
『飛んで行け！100km！山だ！』は、奥スクロールのエンドレスフライトゲームだ。プレイヤーは小さな飛行機を操作し、100kmの飛行を目指すこととなる。
しかし、本作では常に背後から竜巻が迫っており、竜巻に巻き込まれるとライフが減ってしまう。そこで竜巻から離れるために、スペースキーもしくはBボタンによる加速が必須となる。加速すると燃料を消費し続け、燃料は空に浮かぶエネルギーを獲得して回復可能だ。初期機体では加速していると、回避困難な地形に遭遇することもあるため、竜巻との距離を確認しながらいつ加速するのかといった判断が重要となる。そのほか、加速するリングや、障害物を無視して高速飛行するシールド、スコアとなる星といったアイテムを獲得しながら、竜巻に追いつかれずに100kmの飛行を目指すのだ。
また、実績や機体を追加する有料DLCについても、有料化の影響を受けないとのことだ。ちなみに本作は、到達距離1kmごとに実績が解除され、100kmまで全100の実績が用意されている。DLC機体はそれぞれ異なる飛行性能を有しており、コントロール性能が高い機体も存在する。初期機体で難しい場合は、DLC機体を使って実績コンプリートを狙うのもいいだろう。
『飛んで行け！100km！山だ！』は、PC（ Steam ）にて11月16日に有料化予定。ライブラリに追加しておけば、有料化後も無料でプレイすることが可能だ。
本作のゲームプレイは非常にシンプル。自動的に画面奥へと飛び続ける飛行機を、WASDキーもしくはスティックで操作して障害物を避けていく。勝手に高度が下がることはないため、障害物の回避に集中することができる。障害物にぶつかってしまうとライフが1つ減り、すべてのライフを失うとゲームオーバーだ。失ったライフは空に浮かぶハートを獲得することで回復可能だ。飛び続けるほど速くなるといった要素はなく、障害物に当たらずに飛行し続けるのは難しくはない。

packages.headline: Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Bandai Namco has revealed a first look at Tekken 8 DLC character Yujiro Hanma, and the Baki rep is looking just as uncanny as fans expected.
Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected
The new trailer for the fighting game's Season 3 characters debuted alongside Evo France 2026. Following Kunimitsu's release in June and Bob's release in August, kangaroo-and-joey fighter Roger Jr. is now officially set for a November 11 early access launch, with the full release following November 16, but the character most fans are looking forward to is still without a proper release date.
Roger Jr. is definitely the star of the new Tekken 8 DLC trailer, with nearly three minutes of its four-minute runtime dedicated to showing off the marsupial boxer's gameplay. The Yujiro teaser, meanwhile, is tucked at the end, but its reveals are particularly shocking. You can see how the Baki the Grappler villain has been reimagined within the world of Tekken below.
Yujiro is… expressive, to say the least, so nailing his face and bulging muscles was always going to draw attention. Well, the Bandai Namco team did their best, with today's Evo trailer showing just a few shots of his iconic toothy smile and flexibility.
It looks like work on the anime guest character is still underway, but just because there's no release date doesn't mean there isn't a plan to show more. The end of the new teaser promised that a new Yujiro trailer will premiere alongside the Tekken World Tour Finals January 17, 2027. That's three months out from now, so we can probably expect to see gameplay by that point.
Looking back at the calendar, Bandai Namco has typically had a few months of downtime between Tekken 8 DLC releases. It will have been two months since Roger Jr. was released when the Yujiro trailer is shared, meaning we can also expect a release date announcement around that time, too. If we're lucky, the Baki fighter might even drop that same day, but again, nothing regarding his release date has been confirmed quite yet.
Roger Jr. and Yujiro are both included in the Season 3 pass and will round out its promise of four bonus characters. Season 1 and Season 2 included fighters like Heihachi, Armor King, Anna, and Final Fantasy 16 protagonist Clive Rosfield. While passes cost $30 each, the Season 3 pass is currently available for $34.99.

packages.headline: 基本プレイ無料『NTE』新エリア「遊園地」の“汚い遊び方”が流行る。子どもの遊びで暴走する大人の悪知恵、“おみやげ”までズルい

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
『NTE: Neverness to Everness』Ver.1.4で開園した「プカランド」のアトラクションを“ズルく”攻略してみたい。
基本プレイ無料『NTE』新エリア「遊園地」の“汚い遊び方”が流行る。子どもの遊びで暴走する大人の悪知恵、“おみやげ”までズルい
街オープンワールド『 NTE: Neverness to Everness 』（以下、NTE）Ver.1.4で開園した、島まるごとの遊園地「プカランド」。前回は園内を歩き回り、アトラクションの裏側やジェットコースターのレールなど、どこまで入り込めるのかを試した。今回は、アトラクションそのものを“ズルく”攻略してみたい。
ところが、SNSなどを眺めると、さっそくさまざまな抜け道が報告されている。迷路の壁を走ったり、射的の弾を一発増やしたり。せっかくなので、筆者も実際に試してみた。すると、楽をするつもりが別の操作に苦戦し、条件を読み直したら急に簡単になり、最後には園外の戦闘に持ち帰れる強力な“おみやげ”まで見つかった。なお、本稿には一部先行体験コンテンツが含まれるため留意してほしい。
まず挑戦したのは、植え込みの壁に囲まれた「フラワーメイズ」。普通に遊ぶなら、分岐で道を選びながらゴールを目指す迷路である。ただ、『NTE』には空を飛んだり、壁を登ったりできるキャラクターがいる。そうした能力があれば、迷路など簡単に突破できるのではないか。
さて、園内でひととおり遊んだら、おみやげを買って帰りたい。今回気になったのは、プカランドで販売されている回復アイテム「オクトバブルガム」だ。
つまり、所持している分だけ、倒された仲間を次々に起こせるわけだ。もちろん、HP700で復帰するため、そのまま攻撃を受ければ再び倒される可能性が高い。しかし、そこでまたガムを使えば復活できる。通行正義のような致命的な一撃を放つ相手に対しても、倒されるたびに立ち上がるゾンビ戦法を取れるのだ。遊園地で買ってきたガムを頼りに、強敵に何度も食らいつく。迷路や射的でコソコソするどころではない、戦闘の立ち回りまで変えかねない特大の「ズル」は、意外にもキャンディーショップの中にあった。
『 NTE: Neverness to Everness 』は、PC（公式サイト/Steam/Epic Gamesストア/Google Play Games）/Mac/PS5/iOS/Android向けに基本プレイ無料で配信中だ。

packages.headline: 絡み合う愛と悲劇を通じて「自分自身のあり方」が問われる。人間の複雑さを抉る傑作ノベル『ファタモルガーナの館』を今こそ遊んでみよう

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
『ファタモルガーナの館』は2012年に発表された作品ながら、愛と悲劇を通じて「自分自身のあり方」という、現代でも通じるテーマを描いている。
絡み合う愛と悲劇を通じて「自分自身のあり方」が問われる。人間の複雑さを抉る傑作ノベル『ファタモルガーナの館』を今こそ遊んでみよう
連載第12回となる本稿では、ゲーム開発サークルNOVECT（旧Novectacle）が手がけたビジュアルノベル『ファタモルガーナの館』を紹介。2012年にリリースされた本作は、呪われた館を舞台に、時代の異なる悲劇を辿りながら、館にまつわる謎と「あなた」自身の過去を描いていく。美しい西洋風の世界観や重厚な音楽も印象的で、人間が抱える愛情や憎しみ、孤独、「自分は何者なのか」という問いを、丁寧に描き出している点が魅力だ。2015年には外伝作『ファタモルガーナの館 -Another Episodes-』が発売され、現在では「現代編」を収録したコンソール版も展開されている。
『ファタモルガーナの館』の面白さは、4つの悲劇を単純なオムニバスとして終わらせない点だ。それぞれ別の人物が経験した悲劇に見えていた出来事が、読み進めるにつれて館の謎や主人公の正体と結びついていく。プレイヤーは登場人物たちの人生を一つずつ見届けながら、断片的に与えられた情報を組み合わせ、館で何が起きていたのかを考えることになる。また物語の途中で明らかになる事実によって、以前に読んだ場面の意味まで変わっていく。最初は理解できなかった人物の行動に理由があったと分かったり、善意から出た行動が別の人物を追い詰めていたと気づいたりと、結末だけを見れば「悪人」と思える人間であっても、何を考え、何を望んでいたのかを知ることで、プレイヤーの見方は変化していく。
登場人物たちは自分なりの正しさを抱えて生きており、家族ならこうするべき、恋人ならこうあるべき、愛する相手なら自分を理解してくれるはずといった自らの根底の価値観が、別の人間にとっては苦しみになることも多い。誰かを傷つけた人物にも、傷つけられた人物にも事情がある。事情を知ったからといって許せるとは限らないが、理解することはできる。『ファタモルガーナの館』は、悲劇を生み出した人間を一方的に断罪するのではなく、一人ひとりが抱えていた感情まで描くことで、人間が抱える複雑さを浮かび上がらせている。
『ファタモルガーナの館』は、現代の価値観から過去の人物を一方的に裁く作品ではない。むしろ、誰かに決められた役割と自分自身のあり方が一致しないとき、人間はどう生きればいいのかという問題を、普遍的な物語の中で描いている。自分自身を理解することすら難しい人間が、他人を理解することもまた難しいからこそ悲劇が生まれてしまう。
『ファタモルガーナの館』は、悲劇を並べてプレイヤーを嫌な気持ちにさせるだけの露悪的ビジュアルノベルではない。2012年に発表された作品でありながら、今なお読み継がれている理由も、単なる懐古では説明できないだろう。人間関係のすれ違い、愛情が憎しみに変わる瞬間、自分自身のあり方を他人に決められる苦しさといった問題は、時代が変わっても消えない。プレイヤー自身が年齢を重ね、さまざまな人間関係を経験してから読み返すと、以前は理解しにくかった登場人物の感情に気づく場合もある。読み手によって受け取り方が変わる物語だからこそ、『ファタモルガーナの館』は今も遊ぶ価値があるだろう。
また本編を気に入ったなら、外伝作『ファタモルガーナの館 -Another Episodes-』や「現代編」などの関連作品や、スターシステ厶を利用した派生作品『霧上のエラスムス』『セブンスコート』にも触れてほしい。なおNOVECTは現在、新作推理アドベンチャー『Project Code M』を開発中。『ファタモルガーナの館』を入口に、作品を追ってみるのも良いだろう。
Steamでは日々数多くのゲームがリリースされている一方で、個人や少人数チームによる国産タイトルには大作の話題に隠れながらも、独創的なアイデアや強いこだわりを持つ作品が少なくない。本連載「見逃してない？ 国産Steamタイトル発掘録」では、同人・インディーゲームを中心に、国産Steamタイトルを毎回1本ずつピックアップして魅力を伝えていきたい。
主人公の「あなた」は、気がつくと古びた館の中にいた。自分の名前も過去も分からず、目の前にいるのは自分を「旦那さま」と呼ぶ黒髪の女中だけ。女中は「あなた」の館に眠る悲劇の過去を見せ、記憶を取り戻すヒントを得るため、4つの扉を開いていく。扉の向こうに広がるのは、1603年、1707年、1869年、1099年という異なる時代。ある時代では仲睦まじく暮らしていた兄妹が、別の時代では「獣」と呼ばれる男が、裕福な資産家の青年と妻が、呪われた青年と魔女の烙印を押された少女が登場する。登場人物も時代も異なる4種の物語だが、いずれの悲劇にも人間同士の感情が絡み合っているのが特徴。

sources.label: VGC News
sources.evidenceText:
The ‘Cyberleek’ is threatening its biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leak yet, if its demands aren’t met…
Group threatens to leak ‘full’ GTA 6 build if physical plans aren’t reversed
The ‘Cyberleek’ is threatening its biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leak yet, if its demands aren’t met
A group that’s been uploading unauthorized clips of Grand Theft Auto 6 to the internet is threatening to leak an entire build of the game if developers don’t meet its demands.
The group known as ‘Cyberleek’ has been posting authentic gameplay clips from Grand Theft Auto 6 for nearly two months, even ahead of Rockstar ’s own official Netflix reveal . Most recently, the group uploaded 25 minutes of new footage this week.
Cyberleek has previously claimed its leaks were in protest of Rockstar’s decision to sell digital pre-orders for GTA 6 and not offer a physical version . However, it has also been promoting a crypto scheme.
In a new message published this weekend, the group claimed that if its cryptocurrency reaches a 30 million market cap, it will leak a working build of GTA 6, “full story mode, played to the end, credits and all.”
“ Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology,” it said. “They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they’ll pick.”
Rockstar parent company Take-Two will be hoping to avoid another devastating leak in what has been a breach-filled campaign for GTA 6, which will finally release in around a month’s time.
